memberships.page_title: A 38-Dimensional Hessian Quartic from Five Reduction Strategies

statement: For the fixed 38-variable Hessian quartic, Delta^m(Q^{m+1}) is nonzero for every m>=1; an explicit two-parameter inverse ray removes the earlier parity gap and ties every nonzero coefficient to a sheet escaping at the discriminant.
